title: aorfb-cost-audit: Stability Thresholds, Protocol Sensitivity, and Interactive Cost Calculator for Aqueous Organic Redox Flow Batteries
description: Open-source Python library, reproducible audit notebook, and interactive Streamlit calculator evaluating substituent-controlled potential-stability trade-offs, cycling-protocol sensitivity (potentiostatic vs. galvanostatic), and polymorph solubility effects across 42 aqueous organic redox flow battery (AORFB) active materials.
